one_line: Imperial Gurjara-Pratihara king who ruled from Kannauj and led a vast feudatory network across north India in the 9th century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a solid warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium wheatish complexion, straight broad nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing the chin; eyes sharp and determined with a calm, commanding default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, smooth topknot at the crown, the rest pulled back and tied; a simple gold circlet with a small central red gem sits across the forehead just above the brows.
appearance.costume: Layered royal-rajput style outfit: a long-sleeved, thigh-length angarkha-style tunic in deep maroon cotton with subtle block-printed floral motifs in darker red, secured diagonally across the chest; beneath it, cream-colored tight churidar-style trousers; over the tunic, a sleeveless, waist-length quilted vest in muted dark green decorated with small repetitive circular patterns in gold thread, suggesting light armor; a broad golden-yellow silk patka (waist sash) wrapped twice around the waist, knotted to one side with its intricately patterned end hanging to mid-thigh; a large ochre-orange cotton shawl with a thin red border draped over the left shoulder and across the back, leaving the right arm free; simple leather boots rising just above the ankle in dark brown; jewellery limited to a medium-width gold torque around the neck, two plain gold bangles on each wrist, and small round gold earrings.
appearance.signature: A long straight-edged steel sword with a slightly tapering blade, a simple cross-guard and a gently curved hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried sheathed in a plain dark brown scabbard hanging from his left hip.

ref_desc: Mihira Bhoja is a tall, broad-shouldered king with an oval wheatish face, black topknot hair under a gold circlet, maroon angarkha, green quilted vest, cream churidar, ochre shawl, golden-yellow sash, gold jewellery, and a sheathed straight steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Mihira Bhoja standing in a neutral, dignified pose: a tall, broad-shouldered 9th-century north Indian king with an oval wheatish face, sharp eyes, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, and thick black hair tied in a high topknot, wearing a simple gold circlet with a small red gem on his forehead. He is dressed in a deep maroon long-sleeved angarkha-style tunic with subtle darker red floral block-print, cream tight churidar trousers, and a muted dark green sleeveless quilted vest that suggests light armor, decorated with small circular gold-thread patterns. A broad golden-yellow silk waist sash is wrapped twice and knotted to one side, its patterned end hanging to mid-thigh, and an ochre-orange cotton shawl with a thin red border is draped over his left shoulder and across his back. His footwear is dark brown ankle-high leather boots, and he wears a gold torque at the neck, small round gold earrings, and two plain gold bangles on each wrist. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long straight-edged steel sword in a plain dark brown scabbard with a simple cross-guard and a gently curved leather-wrapped hilt. Emphasize the fixed colors—deep maroon, cream, dark green, ochre orange, and golden yellow—and ensure the design looks historically grounded yet clearly anime in style, shown front-facing as a clear, consistent reference for repeated drawing.
